# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    S AS (
        SELECT
            *,
            id - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id)) AS rk
        FROM Stadium
        WHERE people >= 100
    ),
    T AS (SELECT *, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY rk) AS cnt FROM S)
SELECT id, visit_date, people
FROM T
WHERE cnt >= 3
ORDER BY 1;
title: Human Traffic of Stadium
